verdict.rationale: Xero's first-party AI assistant JAX lets users create, edit, and send invoices using plain-language commands, and the homepage advertises instant answers about cash flow and financial health. An official MCP server and AI Toolkit also let external AI agents drive Xero's accounting functions. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language control extends beyond invoicing and financial Q&A to the wider product, detailed docs on JAX command scope or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: JAX is Xero's AI invoicing tool that lets you create, edit, and send invoices using plain-language commands.
Get instant answers about your cash flow, profit trends and financial health.
Get Started with Xero's AI Toolkit including OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP Server, LangChain and prompt examples.
